prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Martín, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Martín thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I just confirmed that the city is shutting down the pool indefinitely because it’s become a total biohazard. I knew those reports about the facility falling apart for years were actually true!"
text: They’re finally closing the pool, though I’ll believe the "biohazard" excuse when I see it. Mrs. Gable told me she saw the health inspector find mold in the locker room showers back on Tuesday.
